brief:
Loomhouse - two campaigns this year, please brief the team on both.

1) Spring Linen Edit (SS31). Objective: drive online sales of the new linen range in the UK and EU. Audience: men and women aged 25-45 who shop for natural fabrics. Key message: "Linen, lived in." Deliverables: 2 Instagram feed images (1080x1350) and 1 website hero image (2400x1200), the hero due 20 February 2031. Usage rights: Instagram, Facebook and website, UK and EU, until 31 March 2031. Mandatory: name the fibre in the copy. Deadline: 1 March 2031. Budget: GBP 12,000.

2) Winter Knit Edit (AW31). Objective: launch the winter knitwear range to existing customers in the UK and EU. Audience: women aged 30-55 who buy natural-fibre clothing. Key message: "Warmth you can feel, made to last." Deliverables: 1 Instagram feed image (1080x1350) and 1 email header image (1200x600). Usage rights: Instagram and email, UK and EU, until 30 September 2032. Mandatory: show the wool fibre up close. Reference: AW30 knitwear lookbook. Deadline: 15 November 2031. Budget: GBP 8,000.
